title: Three Hundred Years
summary: The farewell, with proper coverage: consistent screen direction so reverse angles read as one conversation, escalating framing, and dialogue shot tight so the mouth occupies more of the frame.

scenes.visual: Wide establishing shot of a high green headland above a calm sea, long evening light, a wind-bent tree on the cliff edge. Slow drift.
scenes.narration: Three years he had been happy

scenes.visual: Wide two-shot, the warrior on the left and the golden-haired woman on the right, both full length on the clifftop, the sea behind them. Static camera.
scenes.narration: Three years, and nothing had changed.

scenes.visual: Medium shot of the warrior from the waist up, turned three-quarters to the right, the headland behind him. He speaks quietly. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I still dream of my father.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot of the golden-haired woman from the waist up, listening, head turned slightly away. Static camera.
Medium shot of the golden-haired woman from the waist up, facing left across the frame, the sea behind her. She speaks. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Three years here. Three hundred there.

scenes.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot past the woman toward the warrior, his face small in frame, the cliff beyond. Static camera.
Tight close-up on the warrior, the face filling most of the frame, three-quarter profile. He speaks. Static camera.
Tight close-up on the golden-haired woman, the face filling most of the frame, turned to the left. She speaks one word. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot of the clifftop and the sea, a single small figure of the warrior walking away from camera toward the cliff edge, seen from behind, tiny in the landscape. Static camera.
scenes.narration: Something in him had already left.

scenes.visual: Medium shot of the warrior from the waist up, looking back over his shoulder, the sea behind. He speaks. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I have to see it myself.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot of the golden-haired woman from the knees up, standing still, hands at her sides. Static camera.
Medium shot of the golden-haired woman from the waist up, facing left, wind moving her hair. She speaks. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then take Embarr. He knows the way.

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot, the woman at the right of frame and the white horse at the left, the warrior between them. Static camera.
Tight close-up on the golden-haired woman, the face filling the frame, eyes steady. She speaks a warning. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Never let your feet touch the ground.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot of the warrior mounted on the white horse, seen from the knees up, the sea behind him. He speaks. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I will come back to you.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot of the golden-haired woman from the waist up, watching, not moving. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot of the clifftop, a lone rider on a white horse small against the sea and sky, riding away. Slow drift.
scenes.narration: She let him go, and said nothing
